# Lifted from Construction Manager dev, cm_game_load_setup_effects.txt.
# Renamed cm_ -> bcm_ and nothing else; rebuild after a CM update.
#
# Only the blocks this mod's maps reach: bcm_pf_populate_river_locations, bcm_fpot_recompute_all

@bcm_upgrade_refresh_days_sp = 1400
@bcm_upgrade_refresh_days_mp = 4300


# Populates the global list of river locations for the placement finder's river-adjacency precompute
# in the hidden window GUI. Called from bcm_run_lobby_setup, once per lobby, not per player.
# River adjacency is map geometry and bcm_pf_river_neighbors is saved, so the harvest runs only when
# the save carries no completed one at the current version: a fresh save, a bumped
# bcm_pf_river_version_value, or a harvest a save-and-quit interrupted.
bcm_pf_populate_river_locations = {
  if = {
    limit = { NOT = { bcm_pf_river_data_is_current = yes } }
    # A partial harvest's stamp must not survive the rebuild that replaces it.
    remove_global_variable = bcm_pf_river_stamp
    clear_global_variable_list = bcm_pf_river_locations
    clear_global_variable_list = bcm_pf_river_batch
    set_global_variable = { name = bcm_pf_river_count value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = bcm_pf_river_idx value = 0 }
    every_province_definition = {
      every_location_in_province_definition = {
        # Cleared everywhere, not just on current river locations: a patch that takes a river away
        # would otherwise leave a stale list the path search still reads.
        clear_variable_list = bcm_pf_river_neighbors
        if = {
          limit = { has_river = yes }
          add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bcm_pf_river_locations target = this }
          change_global_variable = { name = bcm_pf_river_count add = 1 }
        }
      }
    }
    # Trigger the river-adjacency precompute in the hidden window GUI.
    set_global_variable = { name = bcm_pf_river_process value = yes }
  }
}

# The is_land gate is the map mode's own first branch, so nothing its colour ramp can paint is left
# unwritten. Called from bcm_run_lobby_setup.
bcm_fpot_recompute_all = {
  every_province_definition = {
    every_location_in_province_definition = {
      limit = { is_land = yes }
      set_variable = { name = bcm_fpot_score value = bcm_location_food_potential_live }
    }
  }
}
